result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active unmatched contributors. Configured teams are unchanged.

**Change:** one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java:747`. A contributor reaches the remainder only if it is not matched by a team and `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped and not added to the remainder.

**Blank dates:** no extra handling was needed. `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date, so those contributors count as active.

**Tests:** `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test` passed with no failures or errors. No existing test covers the landscape team grouping, so this change has no direct test. I did not add one.

Nothing has been committed.
